    34      TwinAccepts [b] := by

== main.c#L129-L143
   129  /* `--jobs=N` (N > 1), the threaded mode. Entry 1 (`ca_start_a`) runs the
   130     stages and phase A in the region and, on success (rdx = 0, rax = 2^63 + k, k pending groups),
   131     leaves the frozen buffer in the array `OUT` (word 1: its length in words). The rest of the region
   132     is unmapped around the buffer, the buffer is made read-only (a write to it faults and kills the
   133     process, which is never an accept: route A), and the input buffer is freed (phase B reads no
   134     byte array). N threads then each map a zero region of ca_worker_size bytes and claim groups one
   135     at a time from one atomic counter, calling `ca_check_b(buf, len, j, region, size)` for each, one
   136     after the other on the region as the previous call left it.
   137  
   138     Concurrency: the threads share only the read-only buffer and the claim counter (each value
   139     0, 1, 2, ... is handed out once by fetch_add); each has its own region and its own result slot,
   140     which main combines after joining them all. A plain flag (a hint, read and written without
   141     ordering) lets the others stop claiming after a failure; it only shortens the run. Accept iff
   142     every thread's slot says that every call it made returned rdx = 0, rax = ACCEPT and the claims
   143     covered 0 .. k-1 (a thread stops only on a failure or when the counter passed k). */

== ConAgua/Final/TwinPooled.lean#L23-L32
    23  /-- **The twin accepts `chunks` with phase B as con-ron's pool.** -/
    24  def TwinAcceptsPooled (chunks : List ByteArray) : Prop :=
    25    ∃ (pins : List NatOpPinSet) (sA sB sC sD sE sF : AState) (pre : PreludeIx) (r : ParseResultD)
    26      (ds : Array IDeclaration) (ipins : List INatOpPinSet) (fe : IFEnv),
    27      internReservedPins (AState.init EStore.empty) = .ok ((), sA) ∧
    28      builtinPreludeE sA = .ok (.ok pre, sB) ∧
    29      parseChunks chunks sB = .ok (.ok r, sC) ∧
    30      preparePrelude pre r.decls sC = .ok (ds, sD) ∧
    31      internAllPins pins sD = .ok (ipins, sE) ∧
    32      ConRon.Arena.PooledAccepts .verified ipins ds sE fe sF

== docs/design/parmode.md#L386-L392
   386  Landing of steps 3 (and lane helper parmode-ni's `L/Agree.lean`, the generic non-interference
   387  lemma (b2): `readsIn`, `Agree`, `invoke_agree`, `run_agree`), after merging tierpool: the pool's
   388  tier 0 (`POOL`, array 0) is a frozen image `[0‥CTL[0])`, the worker owns `POOL⟨1⟩` (256) and
   389  `PT0` (62); the only seed left is `CTL`. Verdicts (`_tmp/parmode/verd_real2.out`, the two
   390  timeouts left out): master, this `ca_start`, `--driver`, `--jobs=8`: 673 fixtures, 0
   391  disagreements. Init after the merge (single runs, load ~20): `ca_start` 22.3 s / 791 MB,
   392  `--driver` 21.6 s / 1108 MB, `--jobs=8` 6.1 s / 1056 MB.

== PLAN.md#L147-L172
   147  ## Bumping the twin (con-ron, and the con-leche it pins)
   148  - **State.** `vendor/UPSTREAM` names the two vendored revisions; `vendor/` is exactly those upstream
   149    files plus the patch series `vendor/patches/{con-leche,con-ron}/NNNN-*.patch`, applied in order
   150    (`scripts/bump-con-ron.sh --check`). Never edit a vendored file without putting the edit in a
   151    patch: edit, then `scripts/bump-con-ron.sh --refresh-patches` (an edit outside every patch lands in
   152    `NNNN-new.patch`: rename it and give it a description), and commit both.
   153  - **Citations** (DESIGN.md, "Provenance: citations instead of fingerprints"). Every L `FunDecl` carries
   154    a line in its declaration block naming the twin code it stands for, at the upstream revision in
   155    `vendor/UPSTREAM`: `/-- con-ron: ConRon/Arena/Core.lean:3682-3688 ConRon.Arena.flushCaches -/` (path
   156    relative to con-ron's `proof/`, the block's line range, the qualified name; `con-leche:
   157    ConLeche/...` for code ported from con-leche; several lines for an L function that merges several
   158    twin functions; `con-ron: none — <reason>` for L plumbing with no twin). New code: write
   159    `@[l_impl T]`, run `scripts/provenance.py annotate` (inserts the citation of `T`), or `locate T`
   160    for the line. `scripts/provenance.py check` (a second, no build) must pass before landing.
   161  - **The bump.** In a worktree on its own branch: `scripts/bump-con-ron.sh <rev>` (e.g. `origin/HEAD`)
   162    re-vendors con-ron at `<rev>` and con-leche at the rev con-ron's `proof/lake-manifest.json` pins,
   163    re-applies the patches with `git apply --3way` (conflicts are reported and left with markers),
   164    regenerates `scripts/census-rust.tsv`, runs `scripts/provenance.py update --old <old rev>`
   165    (relocates moved citations, inserts a `-- con-ron: CHANGED since …` marker under every citation
   166    whose twin code, or a helper right below it, changed, and prints the diffs), builds, runs the
   167    census, and lists the changed upstream files. Fix what the build breaks (vendored files: in a
   168    patch; our files: small fixes now, otherwise `sorry` + DESIGN.md), land it with the markers, and
   169    announce it in DESIGN.md: what changed upstream, the marked items, which lanes own them. The
   170    owning lane checks (and if needed fixes) the L code and proofs against the new twin and deletes
   171    the marker; `check` lists the markers left (the queue; `check --strict` fails on them).
   172    Never bump the toolchain and the twin in the same step.

== docs/deviations.md#L68-L91
    68  ## Fixed
    69  
    70  - **D39** (fixed by lane epochwrap): `scratch_reset` aborted after `2^30` resets (the slot base `B = CTL[62]` at `2^62`); now at `B ≥ 2^62` it vacates the 19 scratch slot tables (the growth's zero loop `kzeroLs`) and restarts `B` at `0`, as con-ron's `HashMap2::clear` at `EPOCH_MAX` (docs/design/epochwrap.md).
    71  - **D35** (fixed by lane tierswitch): every store keeps one word array per tier (tier `t` of array `a` is `a + 256`, lane tierarr's `ld64t`/`st64t`): records `ra⟨t⟩[i * w + f]`, slot tables `sa⟨t⟩` (one KSTP formula per tier array), derived and level-parameter columns `col⟨t⟩[i]`, as con-ron's per-tier `Tbl`s (docs/design/tierswitch.md).
    72  - **D1** (fixed by decls3 landing 4 and lane integrate): `and_pin_ok`'s inductive arm landed (kind `6`) and `rom_and_pin` got L code, so the real `And` block is accepted.
    73  - **F1** (fixed by lane twinaudit): id tables dense + sparse (`IdTable`); ids past the end no longer abort (`e2e/rounds_huge_gaps`).
    74  - **F2** (fixed by lane front2): strings with escapes (`Unescape.lean`, `str_put_esc`).
    75  - **F3** (fixed by lane strlit): `strVal` lines.
    76  - **F4** (fixed by `nat_dec`, `ApplyExpr.lean`): `natVal` past 18 digits.
    77  - **F5** (fixed by lane front2): expression and declaration lines.
    78  - **F6** (fixed by lanes indproofs/indproofs2, landing 6): inductive lines in the front.
    79  - **F7** (fixed by lane romload): pin data as an input.
    80  - **F8** (fixed by lane decls): the readback's `EMemo` mirrored with back references.
    81  - **F9** (fixed by lane decls3): uncached `lvl_eq` in lane induct's code, now `lvl_eq_c`.
    82  - **F10** (fixed by lane whnf): the eager mode-memo take/put banks, via the eager key bit.
    83  - **F11** (fixed by lane libs): dropping the scratch tier cost O(capacity); epoch slots.
    84  - **F12** (fixed in place by lanes indproofs, decls2, indproofs2): `sl_get` out of range, `check_block_agree` on an empty rest, `pin_in` on an empty table, `class_read` wrapping.
    85  - **F13** (fixed by lane whnf2): uncached `lvls_eq` in `iota_rec_at`, now `lvls_eq_c`.
    86  - **F14** (fixed by lane indproofs2): uncached `lvls_eq` in `target_class_match` (was D7), now `lvls_eq_c`.
    87  - **F15** (fixed by helper whnf4-d23): D23, `lp_go`/`inst_lp_core` could not cut off at a parameter-free node (L's derived words kept only the two ranges), so the walk descended into parameter-free subterms and `inst_lp_core` read `ls_node(us)` for a parameter-free `e`. Now the level-parameter bit is mirrored per node (`LpCol.lean`: bit 30 of the five `XDER` words; columns 55‥61 for `succ`/`max`/`imax`/level lists/`sort`/`const`/`fvar`, written when the node is pushed; `ArenaR`'s `*Hp`/`*Lp` fields, `DerR`'s `bvP`/`zlP`), read by `der_b`'s third result (`derLW_ok`), and `lp_go`/`inst_lp_core` test it first, as `instLPGo`/`instLPFast`.
    88  - **F16** (fixed by lane defeq2): D25, `lvl_live` checked `imax` arguments with `lv_node` (a level read before a knot call was not known to read back after it). Now `PoolGrew.lvl` (the level tables only grow) rides in `CoreAfter` and `lvl_den_later` reads the level back; L mirrors the twin again.
    89  - **F17** (lane slotgrow): the cons tables (`SLOT` … `NNSLOT`) were fixed at their whole array and `X_push` aborted at 3/4 load; now they grow like con-ron's `HashMap2` (double and rehash, here at 1/2 load from 8 slots per tier, `SlotGrow.lean`), so a large slot array no longer costs memory or page faults up front.
    90  - **D18/D24** (`hoist_ok`, fixed by lane front3): the ground hoist `hoistNatOpGround` in L (`Checker/Hoist.lean`); `prepare_prelude` reorders instead of aborting (`e2e/natop_order`, `natop_before_ble`).
    91  - **F18** (lane memlay): the cons tables and the memos grew at load 1/2 (no row had recorded it); now at 3/4, con-ron's `HashMap2` load factor (`LOAD_NUM/LOAD_DEN`).

== scripts/e2e.py#L2-L25
     2  """End-to-end differential testing of the L checker (lane `e2e`, DESIGN.md "End-to-end runs").
     3  
     4  Steps (all in _tmp/e2e/<checkout name>/):
     5  
     6  1. **Assemble.** Every `ConAgua` module (except executables and the spike) is imported, in as few
     7     import closures as the modules allow (some clash on declaration names; each clash is reported),
     8     and `ConAgua/E2E/Dump.lean` dumps every binding of an L function name to a FunDecl it finds
     9     (`Prog` lists and `p.lookup "f" = some d` hypotheses). The bindings are merged; the program is
    10     everything reachable from `check` and `check_np` (`ConAgua/E2E/Check.lean`). A called function
    11     with no L code (no binding, or only `abort` stubs) gets an e2e stub with its own code.
    12  2. **Compile.** `check`: the shipped code, printed by `checker.s`'s generator
    13     (`ConAgua/Checker/AsmEmit.lean`; the report says whether the committed file is up to date);
    14     `check_np`: `e2e-l asm` (checks `Prog.wf`). Each linked with `cc main.c` (the entry stub
    15     lays out a fixed partition of one region, lane `abi`: no capacity retries).
    16  3. **Run** every fixture (con-leche's e2e fixtures and the arena tests) through the compiled
    17     `check` and `check_np`, the reference `e2e-ref` (the twin at the program's pin list; with and
    18     without the prelude), and `L.run` (`e2e-l run`) on small fixtures; classify.
    19  4. **Report** `docs/e2e.md` (and `--csv` appends a line to `docs/e2e.csv`).
    20  
    21  Never a merge gate. Niced; every run has a timeout; a monitor kills any run above PER_RUN_GB and the
    22  largest run while all together are above TOTAL_GB.
    23  
    24  Usage: scripts/e2e.py [--no-build] [--jobs N] [--only REGEX] [--rerun-failing [RESULTS]]
    25                       [--trace {disagree,all,none}] [--trace-sample N] [--write] [--csv]

== scripts/land.sh#L1-L8
     1  #!/usr/bin/env bash
     2  # scripts/land.sh <branch> [build targets...]
     3  # Land a lane branch on master, one lane at a time (PLAN.md, "Landing").
     4  # Takes an exclusive lock (_tmp/land.lock), so landings are sequential and the main checkout is never
     5  # mid-merge for two lanes at once. Waits for the lock rather than failing.
     6  #   1. In the main checkout (must be clean, on master): git merge --no-ff <branch>.
     7  #   2. Runs the document link gate (scripts/overview-links.sh; no build, so first).
     8  #   3. Builds the given targets (default: ConAgua) with scripts/lake (which also seeds the shared cache).
